clips.title: The story
paras: In Darnassus, Dawnwatcher Shaedlass keeps watch for the Argent Dawn across Kalimdor. From the Craftsmen's Terrace, he seeks word of his fellow order members sent to scout hostile lands.

The Argent Dawn fights the Scourge in the Eastern Plaguelands, yet its watch reaches beyond Lordaeron. Dawnwatcher Shaedlass keeps the order's interests in Kalimdor from the night elf capital of Darnassus. At his post on the Craftsmen's Terrace, he follows covert expeditions against dark cults and corrupting powers that threaten the wider world.
